summary: This bill is a joint resolution, which is a type of law Congress votes on. The main thing this bill does is cancel a rule made by the Department of Labor. The Department of Labor is a part of the government that handles rules about jobs. The rule they made is about how people choose investments and use shareholder rights. Shareholder rights are the rights of people who own parts of a company. The rule was published on December 1, 2022. If this bill becomes a law, the rule will have "no force or effect." This means the rule will be stopped and people will not have to follow it. Congress is using a power called "congressional disapproval." This means lawmakers are voting to say no to a rule made by a government department. The House of Representatives passed this bill on February 28, 2023. The Senate received it on March 1, 2023.
